findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to every other tenant. This removes the function’s sole authorization check and creates a direct cross-tenant data exposure.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head e7bcd41a6da84f43f3abc968236d5237edfd54f0, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant with documentTenant, so the claimed label-only fix does not restore tenant ownership enforcement.
